note: Low byte of [ebp-4] is written at 0x4adb25 and is the lowest-addressed byte of both the RD16 and RD32 at 0x4adb28; 0x4adb2b and ecx,0xff keeps only it, so ecx and all flags (LOGIC sets cf,of,zf,sf,pf from the masked value) are identical. Uses assumption (a) only.
Both operands are ecx so a&b == a|b == ecx; FL41_LOGIC takes only the result (cf=of=0, zf/sf/pf from it), so every flag and ecx is identical.

Line 27 and ecx,0xff sets cf=of=0 and zf/sf/pf from ecx via FL41_LOGIC, and line 28 recomputes the identical values from the unchanged ecx (no af flag modeled), so the flag state is identical for the jne at 0x4adb33. Both successors (0x4adb37 and dl, 0x4adb06 add) overwrite all flags.
ecx = x & 0xff so bit 31 is 0 and FL41_LOGIC sets sf=0 and of=0, hence sf==of always and (!zf && sf==of) equals !zf. No instruction sets flags between 0x4adb31 and 0x4adb33.

Line 32 sets the low byte of edx to dl, so old edx bit 0 equals dl bit 0, and r = dl & 0x7f has bit 0 equal to dl bit 0; mask 0xffffff01 therefore ORs in an identical bit 0, and bits 1..7 and the upper 24 bits are the same. Resulting edx and flags (computed from r_ only) are identical.

Byte store at 0x4adb3d writes the low byte of [ebp-4], which is the low byte of both the RD16 and RD32 at 0x4adb40; and eax,0xff at 0x4adb43 discards the rest, so eax and the cmp/je flags are identical. Uses assumption (a) only.
